notes.title: The game has fixed 15 bugs!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for the feedback from our players!  
Here are the fixes and optimizations made based on your feedback:  

1. Text encoding issues ✔ Fixed  
2. Multilingual text playback speed bug ✔ Fixed  
3. Developer menu abnormalities ✔ Fixed  
4. HIDE function malfunction ✔ Fixed  
5. Black screen after pressing ESC in the music menu ✔ Fixed  
6. Black screen when right-clicking in the music menu ✔ Fixed  
7. Crashes during the prologue ✔ Fixed  
8. Screen flickering upon launching the game ✔ Fixed  
9. Black screen when loading saves related to trap placement ✔ Fixed  
10. Game reverting to full-screen when switching languages ✔ Fixed  
11. Credits not fully closing after exiting, reappearing when starting the game ✔ Fixed  
12. No response when clicking "Start Game" after a bad ending ✔ Fixed  
13. Unexplained black screen upon launching the game, requiring a PC restart ✔ Fixed  
14. Added ESC to exit functionality ✔ Optimized  
15. Further game encryption ✔ Optimized  

Regarding the beta test appreciation:  
- We have created a QQ discussion group: **1033176415**  
- (Currently, there is only one group, and no secondary group will be created). Feel free to join and share your gaming experiences with us!  

Other optimizations:  
- Comprehensive improvements have been made to the above issues to ensure a better gaming experience.  

About piracy:  
- Many pirated versions have been found online. These versions contain numerous unfixed bugs, lack updates, and may even carry viruses. Only the official version will receive continuous updates. Please avoid downloading pirated copies!  

Once again, thank you all for your support and feedback! 🎮
